purpose: Isolated BioPKS/RetroTide runtime qualification before rejoining manuscript benchmarks.

gate_policy.stage_1: PKS-only max_designs=1 must complete without timeout on at least one canonical PKS target
gate_policy.stage_2: combined PKS+bio max_designs=1 must complete without timeout on at least one canonical PKS target
gate_policy.manuscript_reentry: BioPKS may rejoin only PKS-relevant benchmark records after stage_2 passes reproducibly.

targets.rationale: Canonical flavanone/polyketide-derived target used in prior BioPKS smoke work.
Closely related flavanone with simpler aryl substitution; useful second qualification target.
